question: In which of the following patients would enalapril be the best first line agent for high blood pressure control ?

options.opa: A 62 year old man with renal artery stenosis
options.opc: A 41 year old woman with hyperkalemia

analysis: Enalapril is an angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor commonly used for high blood pressure control. It is contraindicated in pregnancy due to potential harm to the fetus. It is also not recommended in patients with renal artery stenosis as it can lead to renal failure. Enalapril can be used cautiously in patients with hyperkalemia and is often a good choice for diabetic patients with hypertension.
